# ExpoToFunnel

> ExpoToFunnel is a B2B trade show intelligence platform, built and run by
> LeadStrategus. It ranks 17,007 indexed trade shows across 129 countries by
> how densely a company's ideal customers attend each one, then books
> qualified meetings with matched attendees before the event and provides a
> talking points brief for every meeting.

The trade show ranking (top 6 events, fit grades, PDF report) is free,
instant, and requires no credit card. Meeting booking and briefs are
delivered by the LeadStrategus team on a paid package (Starter Pack, Growth
Pack, Full Takeover).

## Sections

- FAQ: 51 answered questions on ranking methodology, the free tier, meeting
  booking, pricing and guarantees (/faq)
- Pricing: package tiers and what each includes (/pricing)
- Privacy Policy: what data is collected and how it's used (/privacy)
- Terms of Service: terms governing use of the Service (/terms)
